## Summary

Describe the focused change and why it belongs in PortWatch.

## Validation

- [ ] `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm lint`, `pnpm test`, and `pnpm build`
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`, Clippy with warnings denied, and `cargo test`
- [ ] Relevant platform behavior tested or clearly identified as untested
- [ ] Tests cover the behavior
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` and `ROADMAP.md` updated when appropriate
- [ ] No telemetry, network requests, arbitrary shell commands, or fabricated OS data added

## Platform notes

List operating systems tested and any permission or packaging differences.
